statement: MediaTek raised its AI accelerator market-share target to 15%-20% from 10%-15% and sizes the 2027 accelerator-chip market (excluding HBM) at $80 billion.
why: A challenger raising its share ambition against an $80 billion accelerator pool is a direct read on how much custom-ASIC substitution the market expects to take from merchant GPUs.

impact.mechanism: A larger share target from a custom-ASIC supplier implies more accelerator volume routed to non-GPU silicon and to the Intel packaging that supports it, at the expense of merchant-GPU share of the same budget.

confidence.basis: Company aspiration relayed in a secondary transcript; the target is a stated goal, not an achieved share.

dispersion: Share target stated as a range, 15%-20%, raised from 10%-15%.
